rationale: The import-validation harnesses now route their existing Pulp targets through governed-build.sh, which centralizes fair-share parallelism and emits the normal build receipt. The scripts retain the same targets, fixtures, visual checks, and external Spectr build boundary; no importer format, generated output, rendering authority, or Vellum ownership changes. This watch-only record covers the path-family selectors crossed by the harness files.
